# BeezKnees

> BeezKnees is a UK-focused beekeeping information resource providing practical guidance on honey bee health, hive management, Varroa, queens, swarming, feeding, seasonal beekeeping, disease recognition, colony problems and digital hive record keeping through HiveTag.

Website: https://beezknees.co.uk/

## HiveTag

HiveTag is a UK beekeeping records and apiary management app designed to replace paper hive inspection sheets, notebooks and scattered spreadsheets.

- https://beezknees.co.uk/hivetag-app
- https://beezknees.co.uk/hivetag-association-partner-program
- https://beezknees.co.uk/blog/posts/best-beekeeping-apps-uk
